name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for rotted window frame replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for rotted window frame replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor, prioritize experience with wood rot remediation and window installation. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, who can handle both the carpentry repairs and window installation. Request references, review their portfolio, and ensure they provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work for both rot repair and window replacement. Local knowledge of Bay Area building codes is also beneficial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed, insured contractor experienced in both wood rot remediation and window installation, with local Bay Area knowledge.
